The '''Bureau of Acculturation''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] organization that was responsible for helping civilizations advance technologically. The Bureau of Acculturation helped the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]] to become ready to join the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] after 500 [[Standard year/Legends|standard years]].
